newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hopewell, CKI in road talks.
newsitem.headline: Hopewell, CKI in road talks.

text.p: Hopewell Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had started negotiations with Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd (CKI) and Chinese authorities on the 20-km south-west section of the Guangzhou ring road in southern China.
But Hopewell executive director Robert Niem told a news conference no conclusion had yet resulted from the talks. He did not elaborate on the details of the negotiations.
CKI was not immediately available to comment.
Last year, Hopewell and CKI signed an agreement with China's Guangzhou Freeway Co to construct and operate the 19-km south-east section of the East-South-West Ring Road in Guangzhou.
Hopewell, a Hong Kong-based infrastructure firm, said on Friday the agreement was amended in February, 1997.
Under the amended arrangement, Hopewell and CKI will jointly inject on equal basis a total of 1.5 billion yuan, reduced from the originally planned 1.9 billion yuan.
The Chinese partner will be responsible for the remaining 500 million yuan and will undertake the land acquisition, design, construction and operation of the section.
Hopewell is assured of a minimum return of 20 percent on its investment in the south-east section of the ring road, it said.
